name: dev-first
description: Plan-first AI coding agent — every request becomes a plan you approve before a single line changes.

commands.title: Dev-First: Add Terminal Output to Chat
Dev-First: Scan Whole File with AI

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Dev-First
walkthroughs.description: Plan first, then let Dev-First build — and learn while it works.

steps.title: Connect a provider
steps.description: Bring your own key — OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, Groq, DeepSeek, or a local model via Ollama / LM Studio.

steps.title: Ask for anything
steps.description: Questions get answers. Trivial changes just run. Bigger work gets a plan you approve before anything is touched.

steps.title: Learn as you go
steps.description: Ask why, open any file mentioned in chat, or hit Learn more for verified resources on the approach and its alternatives.

devFirst.preset.markdownDescription: Provider preset: `openai`, `anthropic`, `gemini`, `openrouter`, `groq`, `deepseek`, `ollama`, `lmstudio`, `custom`. Normally set from the Dev-First panel.

enumDescriptions: OpenAI-compatible API (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, Ollama, LM Studio, DeepSeek, ...)
devFirst.provider.markdownDescription: LLM provider. The **openai** option works with any OpenAI-compatible endpoint — set `#devFirst.baseUrl#` for OpenRouter, Groq, Ollama, etc.

devFirst.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Override the API base URL (e.g. `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`, `http://localhost:11434/v1`). Leave empty for the provider default.

devFirst.model.description: Model ID to use (e.g. gpt-4o, claude-sonnet-4-5, gemini-2.0-flash).

devFirst.maxSteps.description: Maximum tool steps per execution run.

devFirst.headerTimeout.description: Seconds to wait for model response headers before aborting the request. 0 disables the timeout.

devFirst.streamIdleTimeout.description: Seconds to wait between streaming chunks before aborting the response. 0 disables the timeout.

devFirst.autoApproveTerminal.description: Run terminal commands without asking for approval.

devFirst.autoApproveEdits.description: Apply write_file, edit_file, and apply_patch without asking for approval.

devFirst.safeCommandsOnly.description: When terminal auto-approve is on, only read-only commands (ls, cat, git status, npm test, ...) run automatically; everything else asks first.

devFirst.yolo.description: Auto-approve everything: edits, all commands, and MCP tools. Bypasses every approval check.

devFirst.checkDiagnostics.description: After each edit, feed language-server errors and warnings for the touched files back to the agent.

devFirst.autoCompact.description: Automatically summarize the conversation when it approaches the context limit, so long tasks can continue.

devFirst.contextLimitTokens.description: Fallback context window used only when the model is not in the model catalog.

devFirst.semanticIndex.description: Enable semantic_search. Uses a bundled local embedding model by default — no API key needed, nothing leaves your machine.

enumDescriptions: Bundled all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model, runs on CPU, offline.
Use the configured LLM provider's embeddings API (OpenAI-compatible or Gemini).
devFirst.embeddingsProvider.description: Where embeddings for the semantic index come from.

devFirst.embeddingsModel.description: Embeddings model used when embeddingsProvider is 'api'.

enumDescriptions: Run terminal commands without a sandbox.
Restrict terminal command writes to the workspace and common caches (macOS sandbox-exec / Linux bubblewrap).
devFirst.sandbox.description: OS-level sandbox for terminal commands. The approval card offers a one-time 'run without sandbox' option.

devFirst.browserAutoLaunch.description: Automatically launch a local Chrome/Edge with a dedicated profile when browser tools are used.

devFirst.reasoningEffort.markdownDescription: Legacy fallback for model reasoning. Use the composer reasoning control to choose a value supported by the selected model.

devFirst.parallelTools.description: Run independent read-only tool calls in parallel.

devFirst.memory.description: Inject project memory into prompts and expose memory_recall/memory_save tools.

devFirst.autocomplete.description: Enable inline code completions (ghost text) using the provider's FIM endpoint.

devFirst.autocompleteModel.markdownDescription: Model used for inline completions (FIM). Leave empty for auto: Dev-First picks a FIM model for the connected provider (Codestral for OpenRouter, qwen2.5-coder for Ollama) and otherwise falls back to the connected chat model.

devFirst.autocompleteFallback.description: When no FIM model is available, ask the connected chat model for the completion. Throttled to one call per second with a small context, so token usage stays low.

devFirst.autoApproveMcp.description: Run MCP tool calls without asking for approval.

devFirst.resources.description: Show the Learn more button on plans and walkthroughs (AI-suggested, verified learning resources).

devFirst.mcpDisplay.description: How MCP tool output is rendered in chat.

devFirst.notifyOnFinish.description: Show a VS Code notification when a task finishes.

devFirst.soundOnFinish.description: Play a short sound when a task finishes.

devFirst.notifyOnComplete.description: Show a VS Code notification when a run finishes successfully.

devFirst.notifyOnError.description: Show a VS Code error notification when a run fails.

devFirst.notifySound.description: Play a short sound when a task completes or fails.

devFirst.notifyOnInput.description: Show a notification when a plan awaits approval, a command needs Allow/Deny, or the agent asked a question.

devFirst.keepAwake.description: Prevent sleep while a plan is running (macOS caffeinate).

devFirst.browserPort.description: Chrome DevTools Protocol port used by the browser tools (start Chrome with --remote-debugging-port=9222).

devFirst.scanEnabled.description: Show problems in files you open (squiggles + hover explanations).

devFirst.scanAst.description: Parse JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, Go, and PHP to catch structural bugs such as unreachable code.

devFirst.scanHotspots.description: Include non-blocking hotspot hints such as weak randomness or plain http URLs.

devFirst.scanDuplication.description: Index workspace functions and flag near-identical bodies in other files.

devFirst.scanCrossFile.description: Flag circular imports, god modules, dead exports, orphaned files, and other cross-file structure issues.

devFirst.scanConventions.description: Mine auth, validation, naming, and layering conventions from the cross-file index and use them when planning.

devFirst.scanDuplicationThreshold.description: Minimum token similarity (0.5-1) before a function is reported as a duplicate.

devFirst.scanMaxFileKb.description: Skip scanning files larger than this (KB).

devFirst.scanMaxFiles.description: Stop indexing after this many files. Raise it for very large repositories.

devFirst.scanIgnore.markdownDescription: Comma-separated glob patterns for files to skip when scanning.

devFirst.scanNewOnly.description: Show only findings that are not in the scan baseline yet. While this is off, every finding is recorded into the baseline.

devFirst.scanAi.description: After the deterministic pass, ask the connected model for high-confidence findings linters cannot catch (logic bugs, smells, security, architecture).

devFirst.scanAiModel.markdownDescription: Model used for the AI scan. Empty uses `#devFirst.model#`.

devFirst.scanAiCrossFile.description: Compare same-concept implementations across files with the model and flag same/drifted twins.

devFirst.scanAiCrossFileMaxPairs.description: Maximum candidate pairs the AI reviews for the opened file per scan.

devFirst.architecture.description: Show the Architecture button that maps the codebase into domains, subsystems, and components.

devFirst.pasteFileLines.description: Pasted text longer than this many lines is saved under .dev-first/pastes and referenced in the message instead of filling the prompt.

scripts.build: npm run build:ext && npm run build:webview
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run smoke
